# `collab/CollabCodec.js`

> **Source:** `engine/collab/CollabCodec.js`

CollabCodec.js Inline MessagePack encoder/decoder for binary collab messages. Zero dependencies — implements msgpack spec directly. Supports: null, bool, int (safe integer range), float64, string, bin (Uint8Array), array, map (plain objects). Special extension type 0x01: Float32Array with canonical little-endian bytes. Usage: import { encode, decode } from './CollabCodec.js'; const bytes = encode({ ch: 'ops', data: { type: 'transform', pos: new Float32Array([1,2,3]) } }); const obj = decode(bytes);
